scope: Independent offline private-message runtime review; synthetic keys only

acceptance_groups.name: private_peer_authority
cases: Absent identity or ledger refuses private operation
Unverified NodeInfo and phone-supplied public_key never create trust
Wrong-key same-node claims cannot replace explicit pin
Another valid pairwise peer cannot authenticate recipient ACK
Self-signed CRC32-bound first contact is observed separately from operator-authorized trust
Key-generation/revocation invalidates old sessions without releasing same-key nonce history

acceptance_groups.name: private_send_and_rf_gates
cases: Explicit private request cannot fall back to Public on any failure
Reply/reaction metadata remains encrypted with original request semantics
Broadcast and invalid-destination private requests rejected before reservation
Compiled RX-only, disarmed, stopped, faulted, busy and airtime-limited paths cannot bypass Service
Active send uses stable buffer until completion
Retries preserve exact ciphertext/id/extra nonce and never call entropy/crypto/storage again
Disconnect/cancel/expiry cannot resurrect pending work

acceptance_groups.name: private_receive_and_replay
cases: Gate exact local destination, channel zero, nonlocal pinned sender, packet ID and bounded size before crypto
Wrong key/from/id/tag/extra nonce fails without output
No Public decode fallback after failed private candidate
Authenticate before replay mutation; commit replay before delivery
Corrupt/readback-failed/full ledger fails closed
Reset replay cannot redeliver
Duplicate ACK requires reauthentication; ID-only ledger cannot claim exact-ciphertext equivalence
No user-controlled inbound pki_encrypted/public_key/ack_proof_status flag is trusted

acceptance_groups.name: private_ack
cases: Cheap pending/recipient/request gate precedes X25519
Absent/malformed/duplicate/wrong-wire/invalid/unknown-key proof never completes private job
MAC covers exact Routing bytes with proof excised, including unknown fields
Authenticated NONE vs NAK vs route-discovery variants interpreted distinctly
Wrong request/peer/destination and replayed completed ACK do not affect another job
Bare Public ACK, app response, NodeInfo request_id and own echo cannot complete private job
Early valid ACK waits for native send completion without use-after-free
No ACK-of-ACK amplification or unarmed reply generation

acceptance_groups.name: durable_nonce
cases: Stable public-key/local-node domain across same-key generation/import/reset
Reservation commits before entropy/encryption
Failed entropy/crypto attempts burn IDs
Uncertain writes/readbacks freeze without retry
No live eviction or automatic reset of full ledger
Different-key migration rejected unless separately implemented and reviewed
CRC snapshots provide crash consistency only; no malicious rollback guarantee

intentional_stock_differences: Authenticated-only private ACK completion is stricter than pinned stock advisory AckProof policy.
Pinned-peer runtime authorization is stricter than accepting self-certifying first contact as sufficient private trust.
No header-only implicit private ACK cancellation.
Fixed no-eviction durable ledgers eventually exhaust and require an explicit future lifecycle; no silent recovery.
No transit-router, key-verification handshake, admin-key fallback, live provisioning or stock-client qualification claim.
